meta.pos: verb; noun; adj.; adv.; noun; verb

defs.def: to make things to be sold, especially in large quantities 生产；制造

ex.s: Many companies are producing fake reviews.
ex.t: 许多公司在制造虚假评论。

ex.s: Each has a personality shaped by the goods and services produced and traded for centuries.
ex.t: 每个地方都有一种由数百年来生产和交易的商品和服务所塑造的独特个性。

ex.s: However, most produce at the store went through weeks of travel and covered hundreds of miles before reaching the table.
ex.t: 然而，商店里的大多数农产品在端上餐桌之前都经过了数周的运输、跨越了数百英里。

ex.s: If your supermarket sells loose produce, then buying smaller quantities is easier.
ex.t: 如果你的超市出售散装农产品，那么少量购买就更容易了。

ex.s: Urban Sprouts’ classes, at two middle schools and two high schools, include hands-on experiments such as soil testing, flower-and-seed dissection, tastings of fresh or dried produce, and work in the garden.
ex.t: “城市萌芽”的课程在两所初中和两所高中开设，内容包括动手实验，如土壤检测、花和种子的解剖、品尝新鲜或晒干的农产品，以及在菜园里劳动。

ex.s: Why was it difficult for ancient human adults to produce labiodentals?
ex.t: 为什么古代成年人类难以发出唇齿音？

ex.s: They produce oxygen.
ex.t: 它们覆盖广阔的区域。

ex.t: 该州去年生产了28亿磅奶酪！

ex.s: To produce new electric components.
ex.t: 生产新的电子部件。

ex.s: It is produced to a dentists' recipe.
ex.t: 它是按牙医的配方生产的。

ex.s: Among the bag makers' argument: many cities with bans still allow shoppers to purchase paper bags, which are easily recycled but require more energy to produce and transport.
ex.t: 在塑料袋生产商的说法中还提到：许多实施禁令的城市仍允许购物者购买纸袋，纸袋易于回收，但生产和运输耗能更多。

ex.s: Producing them requires more energy.
ex.t: 塑料、纸张还是两者都不是

ex.s: Only eleven cars were produced the next month.
ex.t: 但最终亨利·福特生产了一千五百万辆汽车。

ex.s: “The ability to design, build and export green technologies for producing clean water, clean air and healthy and abundant food is going to be the currency of power in the new century.”
ex.t: “设计、制造并向其他国家出口用于生产清洁水、清洁空气以及健康丰足食物的绿色技术的能力，将成为新世纪里实力的象征。”

ex.s: a place to produce and polish shells
ex.t: 一个生产和打磨贝壳的地方

ex.s: Humans produce more than 300 million tons of plastic every year.
ex.t: 人类每年生产超过3亿吨塑料。

ex.s: be produced in factories in future
ex.t: 未来在工厂中生产

ex.s: A computer analysis blindly compared calls produced by mothers and chicks, ranking them by similarity.
ex.t: 计算机分析在不知情的情况下比较了母亲和幼鸟发出的叫声，并按相似度排序。

ex.s: Farmers in many countries are also adapting like this—either by growing new produce, or by growing the same things differently.
ex.t: 许多国家的农民也在这样适应——要么种植新的农产品，要么用不同的方式种植同样的东西。

ex.s: So far, this model ____19____ (produce) well-known universities, but it is now challenged by the digitalisation of society, which allows everybody ____20____ is connected to the Internet to access learning resources.
ex.t: 迄今为止，这种模式____19____（造就了）知名大学，但它现在受到社会数字化的挑战，数字化让每个____20____（连接）互联网的人都能获取学习资源。

ex.s: Producing food that no one eats wastes the water, fuel, and other resources used to grow it.
ex.t: 生产无人食用的食物，会浪费种植它所用的水、燃料和其他资源。

ex.s: It produces kitchen equipment.
ex.t: 它生产厨房设备。

ex.s: It is the production of food, not it transport, that uses most of the energy and produces most of the greenhouse gases.
ex.t: 是食物的生产，而不是运输，消耗了大部分能源并产生了大部分温室气体。

ex.s: Since April drinks companies have been forced to pay between 18p and 24p for every litre of sugary drink they produce or import, depending on the sugar content.
ex.t: 自4月份以来，饮料公司被迫为其生产或进口的每升含糖饮料支付18便士至24便士不等的费用，具体取决于含糖量。

ex.s: 31 For example, farmers, who produce the food we eat, use water to make the plants grow.
ex.t: 31 例如，生产我们所吃食物的农民需要用水让庄稼生长。

ex.s: Farming produced more food per person ___58___ hunting and gathering，so people were able to raise more children.
ex.t: 农耕比狩猎和采集为每个人生产了更多食物____58____，因此人们能够养育更多的孩子。

defs.def: to grow or make sth as part of a natural process; to have a baby or young animal 生长；出产；繁育

ex.s: Rainforests are the lungs of the planet-storing vast quantities of carbon dioxide and producing a significant amount of the world's oxygen.
ex.t: 令人惊奇的是，这些树的生长方式使得它们的叶子和枝条虽然紧密相邻，却从不真正接触另一棵树的叶子和枝条。

defs.def: to create sth, especially when skill is needed （运用技巧）制作，造出

ex.s: Teachers should produce their own teaching material.
ex.t: 教师应自己制作教学材料。

ex.s: However, when a cat is looking for affection, they tend to produce stretched and soft meows.
ex.t: 然而，当猫在寻求亲近时，它们往往发出拉长的、轻柔的喵叫。

ex.s: A few months later, when I repeated the experiment in my home lab, I produced more publishable data.
ex.t: 几个月后，当我在自己的实验室重复这项实验时，我产出了更多可发表的数据。

ex.s: I edit video and produce audio.
ex.t: 我编辑视频和制作音频。

ex.s: When we turn on a light or switch on a TV or a computer we use energy and we need water to produce this energy.
ex.t: 事实是我们很幸运无论何时想要都有干净的水，但这对于世界上许多人来说并非如此。

ex.s: It is good at producing comedies.
ex.t: 它擅长制作喜剧。

ex.s: Your replacement card will be produced free of charge.
ex.t: 你的换卡将免费制作。

ex.s: Your card will be produced free of charge.
ex.t: 你的卡将免费制作。

defs.def: to cause a particular result or effect 引起；导致；使产生

ex.s: When plants disappear, their scents become more difficult to produce.
ex.t: 当植物消失时，它们散发的气味变得更难产生。

ex.s: Oaks and sweetgums, which currently account for a majority of the city’s trees, produce huge amounts of a chemical substance called isoprene.
ex.t: 目前占城市树木大多数的橡树和枫香树，会释放大量一种叫做异戊二烯的化学物质。

ex.s: > The adviser considered the author’s experience in the lab a groundbreaking success because publishable data had been produced.
ex.t: > 顾问认为,作者在实验室的经验是一次开创性的成功,因为已经产生了可公布的数据。

ex.s: A “habit loop(环)” is a way of describing several related elements that produce habits.
ex.t: "习惯循环"是描述产生习惯的几个相关要素的一种方式。

ex.s: Crystal knew that visions alone don’t produce results, but concluded that “we’ll never produce results that we can’t envision”.
ex.t: Crystal知道仅靠愿景不会产生成果，但她得出结论："我们永远无法产生我们无法设想的成果"。

ex.s: One of the results produced by the trial project is                 .
ex.t: 该试点项目产生的结果之一是                 。

ex.s: In some cases, local produce might have used more energy and produced more greenhouse gases than produce grown a long way away - even taking into account its transport.
ex.t: 在某些情况下，本地农产品可能比远距离种植的农产品消耗了更多的能源并产生了更多的温室气体——即使考虑到其运输。

ex.s: We could also say Sometimes, even when we consider food transport, local might have used more energy and produced more greenhouse gases than food that is grown a long way away.
ex.t: 我们也可以说：有时候，即使我们考虑了食品运输的因素，本地食品也可能比远方种植的食品消耗了更多能源并产生了更多温室气体。

ex.s: The process also produces more greenhouse gases.
ex.t: 这个过程也会产生更多的温室气体。

ex.t: 艺术中的运动对观赏者产生什么效果？

ex.s: So they are not producing carbon dioxide and not cause air pollution.
ex.t: 所以它们不产生二氧化碳，也不会造成空气污染。

ex.s: Moderate effort produces the best result.
ex.t: 适度的努力产生最好的结果。

ex.s: Such stimulation produces significant changes in aesthetic appreciation of faces, bodies and artworks.
ex.t: 这种刺激会对面部、身体和艺术品的审美鉴赏产生显著变化。

ex.s: For example, stress could serve as a cue that one responds to by eating, which produces the reward﹣the reduction of stress.
ex.t: 例如，压力可以作为一个线索，人们以进食来回应它，从而产生奖赏——压力的减轻。

ex.t: 它也会产生更多的温室气体。

ex.s: The original reading was either forgotten or so totally absorbed that the new chance encounter with the text produced surprise and astonishment.
ex.t: 最初的阅读要么被遗忘了，要么被完全吸收，以至于再次偶然遇到这段文字时产生了惊讶和震撼。

defs.def: to show sth or make sth appear from somewhere 出示；展现；使出现
if a town, country, etc. produces sb with a particular skill or quality, the person comes from that town, country, etc. 栽培；培养

ex.s: Even though Britain has a reputation for less-than-impressive cuisine, it is producing more top class chefs who appear frequently on our television screens and whose recipe books frequently top the best seller lists.
ex.t: 尽管英国以平庸的烹饪闻名，但它正在培养出更多一流厨师，他们频繁出现在电视屏幕上，其食谱书也经常登上畅销榜榜首。

ex.s: It produces a deafening sound so painful that it temporarily disables a person.
ex.t: 它发出震耳欲聋、令人剧痛的声音，会暂时使一个人丧失能力。

ex.s: There almost are no grades, other than‘Are you working towards your goal?’ Basically, it’s ‘I’ve got to produce this product and then, at the end of year, present it to NASA.’ Engineers come and really do an in-person review, and…it’s not a very nice thing at time.
ex.t: 几乎没有任何成绩，除了“你在朝目标努力吗？”基本上就是“我得做出这个产品，然后年底把它展示给NASA。”工程师真的会来做当面评审，而且……这有时并不是件愉快的事。

ex.s: a factory that produces currency
ex.t: 一家印制货币的工厂。
